lenses.failure_description: The handoff does not establish which saved notes are included when the command is invoked without an explicit selection.
lenses.observable_signal: Two conforming implementations export different note sets from the same saved-note state.
lenses.why_material: Export scope determines the command's primary output and can cause unintended disclosure or incomplete exports.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Create multiple saved notes across plausible scopes, invoke the command without a selection, and compare the exported set with the stated requirement.

lenses.failure_description: The handoff leaves unclear whether existing note content includes only the visible body or also titles, metadata, formatting, attachments, and exact text structure.
lenses.observable_signal: An exported note is readable but omits or transforms information that users regard as part of the saved note.
lenses.why_material: The preservation goal cannot be implemented consistently without an observable boundary for note content.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Save a note containing a title, structured text, metadata, and an attachment reference, then inspect which elements survive export.

lenses.failure_description: The command's accepted invocation forms, required arguments, and behavior for invalid or missing arguments are not specified.
lenses.observable_signal: Users cannot predict whether an invocation will export, reject input, or select an unintended note.
lenses.why_material: Ambiguous command interaction makes otherwise correct export behavior inaccessible or unsafe.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Exercise the command with no arguments, a valid selector, an unknown selector, and extra arguments; compare each visible outcome with the handoff.

lenses.failure_description: The handoff does not define where exported data appears or how an output destination is communicated to the user.
lenses.observable_signal: A successful invocation produces data in an unexpected location or gives no observable way to find it.
lenses.why_material: An export that cannot be reliably located is not operationally usable and may overwrite or expose data unexpectedly.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Invoke export under default and explicitly targeted conditions, then observe where data is written and what destination information is reported.

lenses.failure_description: The synthesized requirements demand compact output while also requiring content preservation, but do not resolve conflicts between compaction and exact retention.
lenses.observable_signal: Implementers either remove content to achieve compactness or retain everything while violating the intended compact representation.
lenses.why_material: The central constraints can drive incompatible implementations unless their externally observable priority is clear.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Export notes containing repeated whitespace, formatting markers, long lines, and empty sections; check whether the result satisfies both stated compactness and preservation expectations.

lenses.failure_description: The handoff does not specify a sufficiently determinate export structure, ordering, encoding, or separation between multiple notes.
lenses.observable_signal: Independent implementations produce mutually incompatible outputs that each appear consistent with the handoff.
lenses.why_material: Consumers cannot reliably read, compare, or reuse exported notes when the representation is underdetermined.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Export multiple notes containing non-ASCII text and delimiter-like content, then assess whether ordering, boundaries, and character representation are uniquely inferable from the requirements.

lenses.failure_description: Running the export command alters saved note content or persistent note state.
lenses.observable_signal: A note differs before and after export despite no user request to edit it.
lenses.why_material: This directly violates preservation and turns a read-oriented action into a destructive one.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Record saved note content and relevant persistent state, run export, then compare the stored note byte-for-byte or field-for-field afterward.

lenses.failure_description: The command produces only part of the requested export while presenting the operation as fully successful.
lenses.observable_signal: One or more requested notes or content segments are absent, yet the visible status indicates success.
lenses.why_material: Silent incompleteness undermines backup, transfer, and trust in the exported artifact.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Request export of several notes while inducing a failure on one item, then compare the artifact and reported status with the requested set.

lenses.failure_description: Verification demonstrates export only for a simple note and does not test preservation-sensitive or failure conditions.
lenses.observable_signal: Acceptance evidence passes while notes with empty content, Unicode, multiline text, formatting, large bodies, or unavailable destinations fail in use.
lenses.why_material: The fixed goal centers on preserved content, so narrow verification can conceal material data loss or misleading outcomes.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Run a small matrix covering empty, Unicode, multiline, formatted, large, and destination-failure cases, and inspect both artifacts and visible statuses.

lenses.failure_description: Observed export failures are recorded without distinguishing selection errors, destination errors, serialization loss, partial output, or source mutation.
lenses.observable_signal: Repeated incidents cannot be tied to a specific requirement gap or reproducible behavior.
lenses.why_material: Undifferentiated feedback prevents later discovery from identifying which ambiguity or implementation behavior remains material.
lenses.minimal_test_shape: Review a sample of reported export failures and determine whether each can be assigned an observable failure type and reproduced from the retained evidence.
